newsitem.title: USA: AAR Q3 aided by trading, overhaul business.
newsitem.headline: AAR Q3 aided by trading, overhaul business.

text.p: AAR Corp attributed its improved February 28 third-quarter earnings to strong growth in its trading and overhaul businesses, offset by lower manufacturing sales.
It said its airframe and engine parts trading and overhaul businesses and its engine trading and leasing operation were particularly strong.

Also in the period, the company completed the sale of two million shares of common stock, raising about $50 million. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes which include fueling internal programs and for possible acquisitions.
AAR, a supplier of parts and equipment to the aviation industry, reported third-quarter earnings rose to $0.36 per share from $0.26. Sales increased to $154.1 million from $136.1 million.
